description:
AI and Mission Data Pipelines Engineer The Opportunity: 
 Mission data is only as useful as the pipelines that make it available. As an Oracle AI Data Pipeline Engineer, you’ll help connect disparate data sources, preserve important context and quality, and deliver t rus ted data for applications, analysts, and AI-enabled workflows.
  
 In this role, you’ll work across data engineering, geospatial data, cloud technologies, databases, and AI. You’ll help move data from source to insight by building resilient pipelines, adaptable source readers, met adata-enrichment capabilities, event-driven processing, cataloging workflows, and secure ingestion services.
  
 You’ll collaborate with data engineers, database spe cia lists, AI developers, cloud architects, security professionals, and mission stakeholders to solve complex data challenges and build capabilities that are reliable, scalable, and ready for operational use. If you’re excited about making mission data more accessible, usable, and valuable, we invite you to join us.
  
 What You’ll Work On: 
 Design and build scalable data pipelines that integrate files, APIs, services, databases, and other mission data sources.
 Develop workflows for data extraction, normalization, enrichment, validation, cataloging, routing, and ingestion.
 Build flexible source readers that adapt to evolving data formats, schemas, met adata structures, APIs, and services.
 Develop met adata-enrichment capabilities that capture provenance, lineage, security attributes, quality indicators, and mission context.
 Design event-driven pipelines that coordinate processing and cataloging across multiple data types and sources.
 Develop pipeline capabilities for geospatial intelligence data, including raster and vector data, while preserving spatial met adata, coordinate-system information, quality indicators, and access controls.
 Apply AI, RAG, MCP, and agentic capabilities to improve data extraction, enrichment, classification, cataloging, discovery, and user access.
 Develop Node.js applications, dashboards, and service integrations connected to Oracle Database.
  
 Join us. The world can’t wait.
  
 You Have: 
 8+ years of experience in data engineering, sof tware engineering, or cloud architecture
 Experience designing and building resilient, scalable data pipelines that integrate multiple disparate data sources
 Experience developing adaptable source readers and met adata-enrichment capabilities addressing provenance, lineage, security attributes, data quality, and mission context
 Experience designing and implementing event-driven or workflow-based data pipelines
 Experience working with geospatial intelligence data, including raster and vector formats, while preserving spatial met adata and coordinate-system information
 Experience applying AI or machine learning capabilities to data extraction, enrichment, classification, cataloging, discovery, or user access, including RAG or MCP
 Experience developing Node.js applications, dashboards, and service integrations connected to Oracle Database
 Active TS/SCI clearance; willingness to take a polygraph exam
 Bachelor’s degree
  
 Nice If You Have: 
 Experience with Oracle AI Database 26ai, Oracle Exadata, or OCI Autonomous AI Database Service on Exadata
 Experience enabling AI use cases with Oracle vector data types, RAG, and MCP
 Experience designing multi-model Oracle Database solutions using relational, spatial, JSON, including JSON Relational Duality, and graph data types
 Experience with data catalogs, workflow orchestration, event streaming, data quality platforms, and lineage tools
 Experience migrating systems or data pipelines from AWS or on-premises environments into OCI
 Experience with Authority to Operate processes, security documentation, or compliance requirements
 Knowledge of OCI and secure cloud-native data pipeline deployment patterns
 Possession of strong communication and collaboration skills
  
 Clearance: 
 Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.  
  
 
 Compensation 
 At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.
 
Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date. 
 Identity Statement 
 As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.
 
 Candidate AI Usage Policy 
 AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided . 

 Work Model 
Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.
 Remote : If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
 Hybrid : If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
 Onsite : If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.
 
 Commitment to Non-Discrimination 
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.
